incidents.name: BonqDAO Tellor oracle price manipulation
incidents.notes: BonqDAO read wALBT's price straight from TellorFlex's latest report instead of getDataBefore(), and staking as a Tellor reporter cost far less than the borrow it unlocked, so the attacker reported an absurdly high wALBT price and minted 100.5M BEUR against a trove, then reported an absurdly low one and liquidated other users' wALBT troves.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x8f55d884cad66b79e1a131f6bcb0e66f4fd84d5b created 2022-11-06T03:05:11Z by 0xd936413365550ec6f390bdd5849ffd813fdf4e11, not the attack-tx sender 0xcacf2d28b2a5309e099f0c6e8c60ec3ddf656642; no EIP-1967 events, 87.6 days old. The second transaction 0xa02d0c3d16d6ee0e0b6a42c3cc91997c2b40c87d777136dedebe8ee0f47f32b1 performs the liquidation leg and is not recorded separately. BEUR and ALBT are the project's own illiquid tokens and the nominal ~$88M headline was never realisable, so no lossUsd is asserted; realised proceeds were still far above the $1,000 floor.
